resources.name: guide-index
resources.title: Glacier agent guide: sections
resources.description: The agent guide's sections with their numbers, titles and sizes. Start here: read the sections you need with glacier://guide/<section> (1-3 and 9 before your first edit), each small enough for one read.

resources.name: guide
resources.title: Glacier agent guide
resources.description: How to build and edit Red Faction levels with Glacier, as one document: the build-look-check loop, the world model, the design kit, discovery, editing existing levels, the verification checklist, pitfalls and a worked example. It is long; a client that cuts long reads short should read glacier://guide/index and the sections instead.

resources.name: conventions
resources.title: Scripting conventions
resources.description: Units, axes, rotation, CSG time order, texture scale and the other rules every script follows (the same text as ged.conventions).

resources.name: api-index
resources.title: Lua API index
resources.description: One line per global, type and design-kit function. Read one entry with glacier://api/lua/<name> (e.g. level.brush, kit.room).

resources.name: api-stub
resources.title: Lua API stub
resources.description: The scripting API as an annotated Lua stub (signatures and types of every global and member).

resources.name: kit
resources.title: Design kit reference
resources.description: Every design-kit function (local kit = ged.import("kit")) with its option keys, types, defaults and meaning.

resources.name: kit-source
resources.title: Design kit source
resources.description: The design kit's Lua source as shipped with this build (scripts/lib/kit.lua, then each kit_* module it installs functions from): read it to see exactly what a kit function builds.

resources.name: norms
resources.title: Corpus norms: metrics
resources.description: The corpus norms built into Glacier: every level metric (doorway and corridor sizes, headroom, light density, texture tiling, ...) with unit, reliability, use and published buckets. Read one metric with glacier://norms/<metric> (e.g. opening.width).

resources.name: level-summary
resources.title: Open level summary
resources.description: A brief structured summary of the level open in this session (the level_summary tool with detail brief). Read it again after a change; it is not pushed.

resourceTemplates.name: guide-section
resourceTemplates.title: Glacier agent guide section
resourceTemplates.description: One section of the agent guide by number (glacier://guide/3 is the core loop, 9 the checklist); a long section is split into lettered parts (6a, 6b). glacier://guide/index lists them all.

resourceTemplates.name: api-entry
resourceTemplates.title: Lua API entry
resourceTemplates.description: One global, type or member of the Lua scripting API, or a design-kit function: level, brush, level.brush, brush:set_pos, kit.room.

resourceTemplates.name: norms-metric
resourceTemplates.title: Corpus norms: one metric
resourceTemplates.description: One metric of the corpus norms with its percentiles (p5, p25, p50, p75, p95, n) in every published bucket (exemplar, overall, dm, ctf, sp, ...).

prompts.name: blockout_from_brief
prompts.title: Block out a level from a brief
prompts.description: Plan, then block out a new level with the design kit from a written brief, verify it, and report what the designer should refine.

arguments.name: brief
arguments.description: What the level should be: size, rooms or areas, connections, storeys, items, mood.

arguments.name: gametype
arguments.description: The game type it is for, e.g. deathmatch, CTF, team deathmatch, single player.

prompts.name: audit_level
prompts.title: Review the open level
prompts.description: Read-only review of the open level: summary, plan renders of every storey, holes and lint; findings with UIDs and positions, no edits.

arguments.name: focus
arguments.description: What to look at most closely, e.g. spawns, lighting, leaks, links, item placement.

prompts.name: extend_level
prompts.title: Extend the open level
prompts.description: Add to the open level: checkpoint, study the surroundings, build the addition with the design kit, diff to confirm, verify.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: What to add and where, e.g. "a balcony over the north hall reached by stairs from the east corridor".

prompts.name: fix_leaks
prompts.title: Fix leaks
prompts.description: Find the open level's holes with check_holes, render around them, make the smallest repair, and re-check until it is watertight.
